issues.description: A newly generalized NodeHelper reconstruction lemma grants get_child(get_parent(nid), get_offset(nid)) == nid through admit instead of deriving it from the node trace representation.
issues.rationale: The public lemma applies to every valid non-root node ID and is reused to distinguish sibling offsets. In this revision, its full reconstruction equality crosses an admit boundary, so any mismatch among get_parent, get_offset, and get_child would be accepted as a theorem. The direct child commit proves the equality from the checked nid-to-trace and trace-to-nid soundness facts and the identity trace.drop_last().push(trace.last()) == trace.
issues.source_evidence: after/lock-protocol/src/spec/utils.rs lines 1666-1680 contains the generalized admitted theorem. Official direct repair 27231bec4b98f6c9d842390e7108e36e9001ff92 removes the admit and supplies the trace reconstruction proof. The narrower admitted sibling-offset proof in the comparison parent is not represented as a separate root.
issues.verification: Fixed-source theorem and direct repair-diff analysis. Historical Verus was not executed.
